Harvey Ink introduction audio, 2026-11-08

assets/midnight-paper.mp3 — "Midnight Paper", an original 20-second
96 BPM loop arranged for electric keys, bass, brushed drums and reed synth.
Composed and rendered for this site. Reference for atmosphere: Balatro's
original soundtrack by LouisF, https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834460/.

assets/harvey-yay.mp3 — original D6/9 title chord with a two-part harmony
mixed from pitch and timing edits of the human recording "Joyful - YAY"
by Sadiquecat, Creative Commons Zero 1.0.
https://freesound.org/people/Sadiquecat/sounds/801292/
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Both rendered files are served locally with the site. The rising air sound
is generated in the browser as the visitor draws a circle.
